segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the product as effective without causing breakouts, and one groups it among a shortlist of skin types, sensitive, oily and mature, for which she found it well suited despite the price.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin find it gentle and effective when followed by a rich moisturizer, clearing flakiness and dry patches, though a couple note their skin feels dry immediately after use and needs that moisturizer step, and one reviewer with dry, normal-combination skin reports it stripped her barrier and caused a large breakout.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally report good results, from clearer breakouts to a smoother, more even texture with regular use, though one needs to follow up with moisturizer to avoid dryness afterward and another, describing dry, normal-combination skin, had the opposite experience of a barrier-compromising breakout.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most represented group and mostly describe the product as gentle enough for regular or even daily use without breakouts or irritation, with a couple choosing to use it less than daily, or pairing it with extra moisturizer, as a precaution.
segments.mature: The handful of older reviewers, in their 40s to late 60s, describe the product as gentle on their skin, with one crediting it with a more youthful-looking, smoother appearance.

concerns.aging: Only a couple of reviewers frame their experience around age, one saying it keeps her 40-year-old skin looking more youthful and another, in her late 60s, describing it as gentle enough for her nightly routine.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin mostly say the product works well paired with a rich moisturizer and helps with flaking, though a couple note their skin feels dry right after use and needs that moisturizer follow-up, and one reviewer reports it stripped her skin barrier and triggered a large breakout.
concerns.redness: One reviewer who says she tends toward redness reports none while using the product; another describes an irritation similar to a mild chemical burn, with her cheeks and temples feeling windchapped.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product removed her skin barrier and triggered a large breakout on her dry, normal-combination skin, and suggests it may suit oilier skin with a sturdier barrier better; most other reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, do not report barrier issues.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a fading of dark spots and hyperpigmentation and a more even skin tone, including one whose two dark spots on her cheekbones cleared and another with hyperpigmentation-prone skin who saw significant improvement.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts, clearer skin, or resolved blackheads, including users with hormonal acne, closed comedones, and persistent nose blackheads; dissent comes from one reviewer whose skin broke out badly and lost barrier function, and another who noticed mild new breakouts compared with her previous scrub.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers dealing with oiliness, large pores, or a build-up of oil and dead skin in the T-zone report visible improvement, including cleared blackheads and smoother pores, with one reviewer explicitly finding it well suited to oily skin without breakouts.

extraits.texte: Got this as a free sample, used it three times a day or so gap in-between uses. Unfortunately, this removed my skin barrier on my dry/normal combo skin, causing a large break out. Believe this product would work best for more oily leaning skin types that have a good natural barrier.

I usually like Dermalogica, but I am not a fan of this. I know people love this product, but I have a couple of issues with it. One, the smell is awful and not something I am interested in while doing my skincare. Two, the more important issue, this irritated my skin almost like a chemical burn, but not severe. It made my cheeks and temples feel like I had windchapped skin. Sad to say that this didn't work for me or at least this brand's formulation.

extraits.titre: The best exfoliator I have ever used
extraits.texte: I purchased the trial size because I wanted to make sure I liked this product before purchasing the full size (it's expensive!). I have to say the price is worth it here. This is so gentle and yet my skin is drastically changed after just one application. I have super dry skin and this in combination with a good moisturizer has CHANGED my skin. There's really no scent that I can detect—which is exactly what I want from my skincare. The only downside is that yes, it is a little messy at times. But I like being able to choose how much I want to use at one time. I recommend having a small cup/container to mix it in if you find it's too messy to do so in your hands.

Great for everyday use. Gentle exfoliation that you can use even in your back ❤️. Definitely recommend for any hyperpigmentation or if you want a smoother skin texture. I have melanated skin with hyperpigmentation and hormonal breakouts and havent had any since using these products
This is gentle enough for my dry and sensitive skin but still very effective for keeping my 40 year old skin looking more youthful. I get a lot of compliments on my skin.
